pairs.target: fùhé shì de zhuō bǐ fēng zhàn nà zhāng zhǎi , guāng què gèngwěn .
pairs.english: The review-room table was narrower than Wind Trestle's, but its light steadier.
pairs.hanzi: 复核室的桌比风栈那张窄，光却更稳。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī dǎkāi bǎoguǎn guì , xiān ràng tǎ wéi kàn fēngtiáo hé jìcún jìlù , zài jiāng tā yuánlái nà duì tiě tóng jiājù bǎi dào zhuōshàng .
pairs.english: Teacher Vey opened the storage cupboard, showed Tavi the seal and holding record, then set his original iron pair and fixture on the table.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师打开保管柜，先让塔维看封条和寄存记录，再将他原来那对铁同夹具摆到桌上。

pairs.target: tiěmiàn méiyǒu yīnwèi jiǔbié biàn xiǎnde mòshēng , zhēnzhèng mòshēng de shì tā shēnshǒu shí , jìng xiān kàn le yìyǎn pángbiān yǒuméiyǒu rén yào zhuǎnshēn jīngguò .
pairs.english: The metal hadn't grown unfamiliar in absence; what was strange was that before reaching, he checked whether someone nearby needed to turn past him.
pairs.hanzi: 铁面没有因为久别便显得陌生，真正陌生的是他伸手时，竟先看了一眼旁边有没有人要转身经过。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng zuòzài cèbiān , bàogào yǐ tānkāi .
pairs.english: Ruan Heng sat at the side with the report open.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡坐在侧边，报告已摊开。

pairs.target: tā búshì lái tì tǎ wéi shuō zhèxiē rìzi zuò dé búcuò , wéi lǎoshī wèn dào cháng liáng nà zhāng tú shí , tā zhī jiāng yuántú tóng gǎitú fàng qí , jiào tǎ wéi zìjǐ jiǎng .
pairs.english: He hadn't come to praise Tavi's recent work for him. When Vey asked about the beam drawing, he only aligned the original and revision, letting Tavi explain.
pairs.hanzi: 他不是来替塔维说这些日子做得不错，维老师问到长梁那张图时，他只将原图同改图放齐，叫塔维自己讲。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiǎngwán , lǎoshī ná qǐ wēn xiù gěi de fèi mùtiáo , kànjiàn shàngtóu nà dào sǎo guò wàicè de wān , biàn jiāng tā gē dào jiājù páng .
pairs.english: After his account, she set Wenxiu's scrap strip and its outer-turn sweep beside the fixture.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维讲完，老师拿起温岫给的废木条，看见上头那道扫过外侧的弯，便将它搁到夹具旁。

pairs.target: tā wèn tā , ruò jīnrì huàn le qīngzǎi zuòyòng de wèizhì , xiānqián xiāngtóng de zhǐzhēn yídòng hái suànbusuàn xiāngtóng .
pairs.english: She asked: if the light load's point of action changed today, would equal needle travel still count as equal?
pairs.hanzi: 她问他，若今日换了轻载作用的位置，先前相同的指针移动还算不算相同。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu qiǎng zhe dá , xiān jiāng liǎngbiān gànggǎn de chángdù yǔ zuòyòngdiǎn lièchūlái , suàn wán cái shuō , dé xiān huàn dào tóngyì bǎ bǐjiào de chǐ shàng , bùnéng zhuī zhe liǎnggēn zhēn zǒu dé yíyàng yuǎn .
pairs.english: Rather than rushing, he listed lever lengths and action points and calculated: first put them on the same comparison scale, not chase equal distances on two needles.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有抢着答，先将两边杠杆的长度与作用点列出来，算完才说，得先换到同一把比较的尺上，不能追着两根针走得一样远。

pairs.target: zhè shì tā cóngqián zài ruǎn héng nàlǐ àn huíxìn liàn guò de bùjú , jīnrì yòng de réng shì nà duì yǐzhī xiāngróng , zhěngkuài tǐjī hé guò de xiǎo tiěliào .
pairs.english: This was the layout he'd practiced under Ruan Heng's written instruction before, still with his known compatible small iron pair whose whole volumes had been checked.
pairs.hanzi: 这是他从前在阮衡那里按回信练过的布局，今日用的仍是那对已知相容、整块体积核过的小铁料。

pairs.target: wéi lǎoshī ràng tā chóngxīn liáng , bìng méiyǒu yīnwèi jìlù shàng xiě guò biàn shěngdiào .
pairs.english: Vey had him measure again, not omit it because records said so.
pairs.hanzi: 维老师让他重新量，并没有因为记录上写过便省掉。

pairs.target: qiǎn cáo , jiēchùmiàn , zhīdiǎn yǔ zhǐ dǎng zhúxiàng chá guò , qīngzǎi wèi jiè shí de shù yě zài zhǐ shàng gè liú yìlán , tā yòu jiāng liǎngzhīshǒu yào luò , yào shōu de wèizhì zhǐ gěi lǎoshī kàn .
pairs.english: Shallow grooves, contact patches, supports and stops were checked item by item, ordinary light-load readings in separate columns; he showed the teacher where both hands would land and withdraw.
pairs.hanzi: 浅槽、接触面、支点与止挡逐项查过，轻载未借时的数也在纸上各留一栏，他又将两只手要落、要收的位置指给老师看。

pairs.target: dìyībiàn zhǐshì shùnzhe dòngzuò zǒu , tā méi jiè xìng .
pairs.english: His first run was movement only, no borrowing.
pairs.hanzi: 第一遍只是顺着动作走，他没借性。

pairs.target: zuǒshǒu ruò cóng zuì shěngshì de fāngxiàng tuì , xiùkǒu huì sǎo guò dúshù yòng de xiǎo piàn zhǐ .
pairs.english: His left sleeve would brush a small reading sheet when withdrawing by the easiest route.
pairs.hanzi: 左手若从最省事的方向退，袖口会扫过读数用的小片纸。

pairs.target: tā jiāng zhǐ yíkāi , lǎoshī què jiào tā xiān bié yí , wèn ruò nà shì bùnéng nuó de zhīzuò zěnmebàn .
pairs.english: He moved the paper, but Vey stopped him: what if it were an immovable support?
pairs.hanzi: 他将纸移开，老师却叫他先别移，问若那是不能挪的支座怎么办。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi tíng le yíhuìer , jiāng yǐzi zhuǎn le xiǎo bàngè jiǎo , chóngxīn bǎishǒu , zài kàn zhǐzhēn , shìxiàn zhōngyú búbì cóng zìjǐ de shǒuwàn dǐxià zuànguòqù .
pairs.english: After pausing he rotated his chair a little and reset his hands; his view of the needles finally needn't pass under his own wrist.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维停了一会儿，将椅子转了小半个角，重新摆手，再看指针，视线终于不必从自己的手腕底下钻过去。

pairs.target: dédào zhǔnxǔ hòu , tā cái jiāng liǎngshǒu jiēshàng tiěmiàn .
pairs.english: Only with permission did he contact the iron with both hands.
pairs.hanzi: 得到准许后，他才将两手接上铁面。

pairs.target: shúxī de zǔlì bìng búshì yì shēnshǒu biàn kěn tīnghuà , tā xiān děng zhùyì luò wěn , cái qīngqīng gǎidòng liǎngbiān de tánxìng xiǎngyìng .
pairs.english: Familiar resistance didn't immediately obey; he let his attention settle before gently changing the pair's elastic responses.
pairs.hanzi: 熟悉的阻力并不是一伸手便肯听话，他先等注意落稳，才轻轻改动两边的弹性响应。

pairs.target: yìbiān zhēn xiàngwàizǒu , lìngyìbiān xiàng lǐ tuì , jùlí bìng bù xiāngděng , huànsuàn hòu de biànhuà què luò zài xiānqián hé hǎo de xiǎofú lǐ .
pairs.english: One needle moved outward, the other inward, unequal distances but normalized changes inside the previously checked small range.
pairs.hanzi: 一边针向外走，另一边向里退，距离并不相等，换算后的变化却落在先前核好的小幅里。

pairs.target: tā méiyǒu táishǒu liú yú xìng , yě méiyǒu jiào ruǎn héng gǎnzhe chuān xiāo .
pairs.english: He didn't lift his hands to leave residue or ask Ruan Heng to rush a pin in.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有抬手留余性，也没有叫阮衡赶着穿销。

pairs.target: liǎngshǒu réng tiēzhe , àn xué guò de bànfǎ shōuhuí jiè xìng , qīngzǎi dúshù gè huí jīxiàn , cái táishǒu , xièzài , zài chá zhèngcháng .
pairs.english: Keeping both hands touching, he canceled borrowing as learned; each light-load reading returned to baseline before he lifted, unloaded and checked normality again.
pairs.hanzi: 两手仍贴着，按学过的办法收回借性，轻载读数各回基线，才抬手、卸载，再查正常。

pairs.target: zuò wán yíbiàn , yǎn hòu nà gǔ xì jǐn cái bèi tā zhùyì dào , wéi lǎoshī ràng tā zuò kāi xiūxi , búzài jiē dìèrbiàn .
pairs.english: After one trial he noticed the fine tightness behind his eyes. Vey seated him to rest, no second run.
pairs.hanzi: 做完一遍，眼后那股细紧才被他注意到，维老师让他坐开休息，不再接第二遍。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi wàng zhe jiājù , méi wèn shìbushì yòu zhǐnéng liàn jiù dōngxī .
pairs.english: Watching the fixture, Tavi didn't ask if it meant old tools again.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维望着夹具，没问是不是又只能练旧东西。

pairs.target: lǎoshī què zhǔdòng jiāng lìng yìzhāng kōng tú gěi tā , ràng tā xiàhuí xiān zài zhǐ shàng ānpái tóngyí duì cáiliào de bùtóng zhuāngpèi , xiě qīng zěnyàng hé , shuí lái zuò nǎ yíbù , nǎxiēdìfāng hái xū qǐng rén quèrèn .
pairs.english: Vey offered him a blank drawing sheet herself: next time he should first plan a different assembly on paper using the same materials, explaining checks, each person's actions and what needed confirmation.
pairs.hanzi: 老师却主动将另一张空图给他，让他下回先在纸上安排同一对材料的不同装配，写清怎样核、谁来做哪一步，哪些地方还须请人确认。

pairs.target: tú jiāo lái , tā huìtóng tā kàn , búshì xiě wán biàn ná qù shì xīn liào .
pairs.english: She would review the drawing with him; completing it didn't license trying new material.
pairs.hanzi: 图交来，她会同他看，不是写完便拿去试新料。

pairs.target: ruǎn héng zhèshí cái wèn tā , jīnrì tóng fēng zhàn kàn wēn xiù nà huí , nǎlǐ zuì bùtóng .
pairs.english: Only then Ruan Heng asked him what differed most today from watching Wenxiu at Wind Trestle.
pairs.hanzi: 阮衡这时才问他，今日同风栈看温岫那回，哪里最不同。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi yuán xiǎng shuō méiyǒu chuān xiāo , xiǎng le xiǎng , shuō jīnrì zìjǐ méiyǒu kōng bǎ yígè rén de tuì shǒu zhī dàngchéng yígè xiǎoquān .
pairs.english: Tavi started with the missing pin, then thought and said he hadn't had room today to treat another person's withdrawal as a little circle.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原想说没有穿销，想了想，说今日自己没有空把一个人的退手只当成一个小圈。

pairs.target: tā shuōwán dītóu , jiàn bàogào lǐ nà yì gé quān hái zài , pángbiān de shù yě hái zài .
pairs.english: After saying that, he looked down and saw that report circle still there, its readings beside it too.
pairs.hanzi: 他说完低头，见报告里那一格圈还在，旁边的数也还在。

pairs.target: chū ménqián , wéi lǎoshī jiāng cáiliào tóng jiājù hé hǎo , jiāohuí xuégōng liànxí guì bǎoguǎn , méi ràng tā dàidào sùshè chuángbiān .
pairs.english: Before he left, Vey checked the materials and fixture and returned them to the academy practice cupboard, not his dormitory bedside.
pairs.hanzi: 出门前，维老师将材料同夹具核好，交回学宫练习柜保管，没让他带到宿舍床边。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi shōuqǐ mùtiáo yǔ kōng tú , zǒu dào láng shàng , gé chuāng tīngjiàn lǐtou yòu yǒurén zài bào dúshù .
pairs.english: Tavi gathered his wooden strip and blank plan, hearing someone else call readings through the corridor window.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维收起木条与空图，走到廊上，隔窗听见里头又有人在报读数。

pairs.target: tā de shǒu fàngjìn xiùlǐ , zhǎngxīn yǒu yìdiǎn hàn , jiān què bǐ jìnmén shí sōng le .
pairs.english: Hands in his sleeves, palms a little sweaty, his shoulders were easier than on entering.
pairs.hanzi: 他的手放进袖里，掌心有一点汗，肩却比进门时松了。
